variants.prompt: Captured in the hazy, neon glow of a late-night club, the emerald-eyed enchantress exudes a sultry, seductive energy. Her raven tresses cascade over a beaded, strappy top and high-waisted, vinyl skirt, which she kicks off to reveal long, toned legs. The harsh lighting accentuates every tantalizing curve as she leans against a mirrored wall, eyeing the camera with a playful, come-hither smile.
